candidates.name: @prevalentware/opencode-goal-plugin
candidates.reason: Mature plugin providing full /goal for OpenCode with persistent state, auto_continue, no_progress detection, session.idle event integration. KBD auto-installs and configures.

candidates.name: codex /goal (native, Ralph loop)
candidates.reason: Built-in, stable since v0.128.0. Continuation driven by goals/continuation.md and goals/budget_limit.md prompt files. KBD provides these templates and AGENTS.md context prefix.

candidates.name: claude /goal (native)
candidates.reason: Reference implementation. KBD augments (adds multi-phase), does not replace. Single-phase Creation tasks delegate directly to native /goal.

candidates.name: kbd-goal-evaluator (build)
candidates.reason: No platform except Claude Code and Codex has a separated evaluator. sycophancy-correction MCP grades prose quality, not goal conditions — wrong abstraction. Build a dedicated subagent: system prompt grades stopping condition against transcript/STATE.md, returns PASS/FAIL + reason. Small fast model (Haiku or equivalent).

candidates.name: kbd-goal SKILL.md (build)
candidates.reason: Unified entry point. Detects active tool from project.json, routes to correct platform strategy, creates goal.json + child phases, drives the outer loop. No existing skill covers this.

candidates.name: kbd-goal-check SKILL.md for Kimi (build)
candidates.reason: Kimi's /goal next is queue-based, not condition-based. This skill is auto-discovered by Kimi and invoked by the agent after each turn to evaluate stopping condition. Returns PASS (with evidence) or CONTINUE (with next action hint).

candidates.name: goal.json schema (build)
candidates.reason: New schema extending loop.json with phases[] array, per-phase stopping_condition, IDEAS.md/SPEC.md/TASKS.md paths, and human_gate settings. Backward compatible with existing loop.json.

rejected.reason: Grades prose sycophancy, not goal completion conditions. Wrong abstraction.
Less maintained than prevalentWare version; prevalentWare has more config options and active PRD (issue #27339).
